title: Someone Made Claude Code Run 100% Free on a MacBook (Faster Than Cloud Opus)
description:
No API fees. No cloud. No data leaving your machine. Claude Code running entirely on your MacBook for $0 a month.

It's called Claude Code Local — and the numbers are insane:

🧠 122 billion parameter model running entirely on your Apple Silicon chip using Apple's own MLX framework

⚡ 65 tokens/sec locally vs 40 tokens/sec from cloud Opus — and it costs nothing

🚫 No proxy bottleneck — most local Claude setups use a proxy to translate between Claude's API and local models, and that proxy kills speed. This project eliminates it completely. Claude Code talks directly to a 200-line Python server running on your GPU.

🏎️ A task that takes 133 seconds with other setups takes just 17.6 seconds here — 7.5x faster

📱 Control it from your iPhone over iMessage while your Mac does the work at home

The fastest, cheapest, most private way to run Claude Code. And it's completely free.

Comment "local" and I'll DM you the link 👇

#ClaudeCodeLocal #ClaudeCode #LocalAI #MacBookAI #AppleSilicon #FreeAI #AIForDevelopers #MLX #PrivateAI #NoAPIFees #AIProductivity #CodingWithAI #OpenSource #AITools #Shorts
